<function name="GetNavLadderByID" parent="navmesh" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns a <page>CNavLadder</page> by the given ID.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="id" type="number">ID of the <page>CNavLadder</page> to get. Starts with 1.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="CNavLadder">The <page>CNavLadder</page> with given ID.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
